442501.name: Barrage
442501.description: Fires rockets, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

442502.name: Salvo
442502.description: Fires a barrage of assault rifle shots, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

442503.name: Large Caliber Rifle
442503.description: Fires a large caliber rifle, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

442505.name: Laser Strafe
442505.description: Shoots laser beams from all tentacles, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

442506.name: Rapture Absorption
442506.description:
Absorbs nearby Raptures to strengthen itself.
Absorbed Raptures will disappear.

442507.name: Launch Raptures
442507.description:
Summons Raptures.
Summoned Raptures are invulnerable and can only be attacked when they are absorbed by Fingers.

442517.name: Launch Raptures
442517.description:
Fingers summons Raptures.

The Rapture will be indomitable and can only be attacked while it is being absorbed by Fingers.
